subject.title: feat(hooks): emit session prune lifecycle event

question: Should OpenClaw add a core `session:prune` lifecycle hook now, and if so should the payload include tool names or stay counts-only until a safer metadata contract is defined?
rationale: This adds a new internal automation surface in the model-input path, so maintainers need to choose the stable payload and delivery semantics rather than letting the old branch shape define them accidentally.

options.title: Port and harden the hook
options.body: Move the change to the active context-pruning extension, use a typed session identity source, bound hook delivery, and document a safe payload before merge.

options.title: Counts-only first
options.body: Land only `softTrimmedCount`, `hardClearedCount`, `sessionId`, and `prunedAt`, then defer `toolNames` until a broader metadata policy exists.

options.title: Defer this surface
options.body: Keep the linked feature issue open and close or pause this stale branch until hook payload and availability policy are settled.

recommendation.title: Port and harden the hook
recommendation.body: Move the change to the active context-pruning extension, use a typed session identity source, bound hook delivery, and document a safe payload before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He most recently carried the active context-pruning path and the current extension registration where the final contract would need to land.
